name: Kyushu University
description: Kyushu University is a national research university in Fukuoka, founded in 1911 as Kyushu Imperial University. Its main campus is at Ito, on the western edge of the city.
whyIncluded: Kyushu University held its second KYUDAI NOW Forum in Singapore in March 2026, drawing about 140 registrations from alumni, students and companies.

livingCosts.summary: Kyushu University's own approximate monthly living expenses for international students in Fukuoka: housing with utilities, food, public transport, personal spending and books, 12 months a year, without health insurance.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Kyushu University International Student Center 'INVITATION' site, Cost & Scholarships page, 'Approximate Living Expenses' per month (undated, read 2026-10-08): housing = 'Housing and Utilities 15,000-50,000' (midpoint 32,500; rent and utilities are not separated; the low end reflects university dormitories); food 30,000; transport = 'Public Transportation 10,000'; personal = personal expenses 20,000 + books and supplies 5,000 = 25,000 (National Health Insurance 2,000 is excluded). The page's own total is 80,000-115,000. Excluded: Emergency Security Plan 1,000 per year (a one-off student insurance), tuition and set-up costs. Bug fix 2026-10-14: health insurance taken out of the personal line, as the schema keeps insurance out of living costs.

programmes.name: School of Engineering, International Undergraduate Program (Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Applied Chemistry)
programmes.summary: Standard national-university tuition, the same for all students. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees may be revised during your studies. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught programme listed on the International Student Center's degree programmes pages. Kyushu University 'Expenses' page (data as of 1 April 2020, still the published schedule in October 2026): enrollment fee ¥282,000 and tuition ¥535,800/yr (¥267,900 per half year) for undergraduate and graduate school students alike; application fee (¥17,000 undergraduate / ¥30,000 graduate) excluded. National-university fees may be revised during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. Tried 2026-10-13: the Japanese Expenses page (/ja/admission/fees/expenses/) gives the same figures dated 令和8年4月1日現在 (1 April 2026) only; no dated 2024 or 2025 admissions guide reachable in that first pass. 2025 row (2026-10-13, unofficial): JPSS (Japan Study Support) 'International Undergraduate Program (Engineering)' page states admission fee 282,000 yen and tuition 535,800 yen a year 'for the 2025 school year' (page last updated 17 Jul 2025). 2024 still unfilled (2026-10-13): no dated 2024 undergraduate fee source found (JPSS shows only its latest year; NIAD-QE jpcup fee data is dated 1 Oct 2023; the 令和6年度 privately-financed international student guidelines PDF was not locatable). 2024 row (2026-10-13, rung 3): the Japan Times Japanese university guide page for Kyushu University states admission fee '¥282,000 as of 2024' and tuition '¥535,800 as of 2024' (one university-wide undergraduate rate, as on Kyushu's Expenses page); corroborated by the Fukuoka Prefectural Government nursing-school listing (https://www.pref.fukuoka.lg.jp/uploaded/life/728688_62140556_misc.pdf), which gives Kyushu's 入学料 282,000円 and 授業料 535,800円 as at 1 April 2024.
